definitions: To recover from an illness, a shock, or a difficult experience.
To overcome a problem or difficulty.
To accept an unpleasant fact or situation.
To travel across or move from one side to another.
examples: It took her a long time to get over the flu.
He finally got over his fear of public speaking.
You need to get over the fact that you didn't get the job.
We need to get over this fence.
pastTenses: got over (simple past), gotten over (past participle)
